normalizedRules.cumulativeProjection: A projection joined by + combines the listed statistics; HHR therefore settles the cumulative hits+runs+rbis statistic.
normalizedRules.startRequirement: An MLB batter must appear in the official starting lineup for the pick to grade.
normalizedRules.minimumParticipation: No separate HHR plate-appearance minimum is stated after the batter satisfies the official-start requirement; the general rule says a player who plays and exits early remains valid.
normalizedRules.laterSubstituteHandling: A batter absent from the official starting lineup remains void even if entering later as a pinch hitter or substitute.
normalizedRules.intentionalWalkHandling: No separate HHR intentional-walk settlement exception is stated in the verified sources; HHR settles the cumulative hits+runs+rbis statistic.
normalizedRules.tieHandling: A selection that ties its posted projection is void.
normalizedRules.postponementHandling: A baseball game postponed before starting is void unless played on the originally scheduled local calendar day.
normalizedRules.suspensionHandling: If a baseball game is suspended after starting, selections grade if the game resumes within 36 hours of the original start time; otherwise selections void unless the outcome was unequivocally determined before suspension.
normalizedRules.shortenedOfficialGameHandling: A shortened baseball game that is still official grades normally.
normalizedRules.venueChangeHandling: For team sports, a scheduled venue change after entry voids selections.
normalizedRules.incorrectTeamHandling: A player projection associated with the incorrect team is void.
normalizedRules.postStartEntryHandling: A pick used after the game or event has started is void.
normalizedRules.projectionErrorHandling: Underdog reserves the right to void a pick because of a projection error.
